twinWhy: In F the credit answer is never copied to the value the outcome decision reads, so its reject rule never matches and an order over a limit goes on as if its credit check passed. The twin hands the credit answer to decideOutcome as an argument (order-desk.mjs · runOrder); passing true there is the same answer never arriving. Leaving the argument out would not be the same fault: the twin tests `!creditOk`, so a missing answer would reject every order.
